description: Back to jobs New Engineering Manager - Remote Remote/United States- Full-Time Apply FormativGroup is hiring an Engineering Manager to join a Financial Services technology organization that builds and maintains digital products for tax professionals. The team develops internal tools, financial dashboards, analytics, reporting solutions, and other technology that improves how client-serving professionals work. This is a hands-on Engineering Manager role for an experienced technical lead who wants to step into people leadership without stepping away from delivery. You will serve as both the senior technical authority and the people leader: contributing code, setting technical direction, reviewing work, strengthening engineering practices, and helping the team use AI agents effectively across the software development lifecycle. The environment includes legacy .NET/C# services and Angular front ends alongside newer Python, Node.js, and React development. You will help modernize the stack in phases while keeping business-critical components stable. What You'll Work On Lead from the keyboard: contribute production code regularly, use AI agents as part of day-to-day delivery, and stay close to the technical work. Own the team’s technical direction, architecture decisions, long-term technical health, and roadmap across new delivery, modernization, and technical debt. Lead phased modernization of legacy .NET/C# and Angular components while building new capabilities with Python, Node.js, and React. Break work into small, well-bounded tasks and route each task to the best executor - an engineer, an agent, or yourself - while keeping coordination lean and outcome-focused. Own pull request review and provide fast, technically substantive feedback. Build and manage the technical-debt backlog, resolving priority issues directly instead of relying only on delegation. Hire, evaluate, coach, and grow engineers; set the technical hiring bar and help the team work effectively with AI agents. Create and maintain agent operating instructions, verification protocols, and human-in-the-loop controls for code, tests, documentation, and infrastructure changes. Run evaluation checks before merge and retain human-owned merge control for production branches. Maintain strong automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, and uphold consistent engineering practices across design, coding, testing, release, and operations. Drive CI/CD automation, containerized delivery, and Infrastructure as Code for cloud-native applications. Track engineering health and delivery metrics, including required reporting through Atlassian Compass. Facilitate bi-weekly live demos from the cloud environment, including both product features and agent-enabled workflows. Partner with the dedicated production support organization by providing tooling, automation, documentation, and runbooks that make the product easier to operate and support. Reduce operational toil through automation while applying appropriate security guardrails, blast-radius limits, and audit trails to production-touching workflows. Maintain visibility into WIZ Critical and Major findings and drive remediation within required service levels. Keep architecture documentation, ADRs, runbooks, and agent instructions current and usable. What You'll Bring 5-7+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with clear experience as a senior engineer or technical lead and prior leadership of at least one engineering team. Hands-on full-stack development depth and the desire to continue building while managing engineers. Strong proficiency with Python, Node.js, and React for modern application development. Experience maintaining and modernizing .NET/C# services and Angular front ends. Demonstrated use of agentic or AI-assisted software development workflows in real delivery environments, not just experimentation. Ownership of the full development lifecycle: build, test, release, operate, troubleshoot, and iterate. Cloud-native application experience on Azure; AWS or GCP experience is also relevant. Hands-on experience with containerized workloads and orchestration. Infrastructure as Code experience with tools such as Bicep, Terraform, Pulumi, or AWS CDK. Strong automated testing and CI/CD experience across full-stack delivery. Ability to make significant technical contributions, solve complex engineering problems, and make sound architecture decisions. Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. How You Work You are a player-coach: comfortable owning people leadership while remaining an active practitioner. You use AI agents to increase engineering throughput, but you keep quality, testing, security, and production decisions under clear human control. You bring structure without creating unnecessary process and identify technical dependencies, delivery risks, and quality issues early. You are comfortable working in a small-team environment where priorities can shift and where leadership means doing the work as well as directing it. You balance modernization with stability and understand that business-critical systems must continue to perform while the architecture evolves. Additional Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is required. Exposure to financial services, accounting, finance, tax technology, finance transformation, tax software development, or implementation environments. Ability to take ownership of assigned work through completion, including requirements, configuration, testing, debugging, and system/process changes. Bonus Points If You Have Relevant professional certifications or advanced degrees - such as CPA, EA, JD, or a master's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, information systems, engineering, quantitative economics, or a related field - are a plus, but not required. Familiarity with GitHub, GitHub Actions, Atlassian tools, SonarQube, Mend, Aqua Trivy, and WIZ. Experience with micro front-end architectures. Experience modernizing mixed legacy/new technology environments while continuing to ship. Experience building practical engineering guardrails for AI-assisted or agentic development. What Success Looks Like The team ships predictably while maintaining strong quality, testing, security, and release discipline. The Engineering Manager remains technically credible and materially contributes to delivery rather than operating only as a coordinator. Legacy components remain stable while modernization progresses in deliberate, low-risk increments. AI agents are used productively with clear verification, human review, and production controls. Engineers receive timely technical feedback, coaching, and clear expectations, and the team’s technical hiring bar remains high. Operational support improves through better automation, runbooks, documentation, and reduced manual toil. Why Join FormativGroup At FormativGroup, you'll work with people who are practical, collabroative, and focused on solving meaningful business and technology problems. We're growing, which means you'll have opportunities to contribute ideas, work closely with experienced leaders, and help shape how we deliver for our clients. Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa currently. To be considered for this position, candidates must reside in one of the following U.S. states: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, TN, TX, VA, WI, and Washington DC. Candidates residing outside these states are not eligible for consideration currently. We are committed to pay equity and transparency. The compensation range for this position represents our good faith estimate of the range we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation offered will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, education, work location, and internal equity. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for discretionary bonuses, commissions, or other incentive programs, as well as a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off, etc. Estimated Compensation Range: $190,000 - $210,000 USD FormativGroup operates within the critical middle layer of business technology, where applications and systems connect infrastructure to business processes. We are specialists who help the middle market take full advantage of their technology investments with deep, industry-centric expertise, all in one place, to unify fragmented systems. title: Partner Solutions Architect
description: Back to jobs New Partner Solutions Architect United States - Remote Apply Striim, (pronounced “stream” with two i’s for integration and intelligence), is a unified data integration and streaming platform that connects clouds, data, and applications with unprecedented speed and simplicity to deliver the right data at the right time. Striim is used by enterprise companies to monitor events across any environment, build applications that drive digital transformation, and leverage true real-time analytics to provide a superior experience to their customers. At our company, we believe and expect all of our employees to operate as one with unlimited potential and dignity. Striim is seeking a Partner Solutions Architect to serve as the technical leader for strategic technology partnerships across the cloud, data, and AI ecosystem. This role works closely with hyperscalers, database providers, technology partners, and internal cross-functional teams to design, validate, and promote integrated solutions that help customers modernize their data infrastructure with real-time streaming technologies. The Partner Solutions Architect serves as a trusted technical advisor to partners throughout the relationship lifecycle—from onboarding and technical enablement to solution development, joint go-to-market initiatives, and customer engagements. This individual combines deep technical expertise with strong communication skills to influence partner strategy, accelerate adoption, and strengthen Striim's ecosystem. As AI becomes increasingly embedded throughout the organization and product portfolio, this role also leverages AI tools to improve technical productivity, accelerate solution development, enhance partner enablement, and identify new opportunities for AI-driven customer solutions. Responsibilities Serve as the primary technical advisor for strategic cloud, database, and technology partners, building trusted relationships with partner architects and engineering teams. Deliver technical enablement through architecture workshops, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts (POCs), technical training, and hands-on partner onboarding. Serve as the primary technical point of contact for strategic partner programs, onboarding customers from first introduction to production Design, validate, and document reference architectures that showcase Striim's real-time data streaming, Change Data Capture (CDC), data integration, and AI capabilities across partner platforms. Collaborate with partner sales, engineering, and product teams to support joint customer opportunities and develop repeatable solution playbooks. Design and prototype integrations between Striim and partner technologies, helping expand and strengthen the partner ecosystem. Work closely with Product Management and Engineering to communicate partner feedback, influence product direction, and prioritize integration enhancements. Support field Solution Architects and Sales teams during strategic customer engagements involving partner technologies. Develop technical content including architecture guides, best practices, solution briefs, demo environments, and implementation documentation. Represent Striim at partner events, technical conferences, webinars, and customer meetings as a subject matter expert in modern data architectures. Research emerging technologies across cloud, AI, analytics, databases, and streaming platforms to identify new partnership opportunities. Leverage AI-powered engineering, productivity, and developer tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar technologies) to accelerate solution development, improve documentation, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance partner enablement. Explore and demonstrate AI-driven use cases that combine real-time data streaming with modern AI, machine learning, and agentic AI architectures. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 4+ years of experience in a Solutions Architect, Partner Engineer, Sales Engineer, Implementation Manager, Customer Engineer, Technical Alliances, or similar customer-facing technical role. Experience managing customer implementations, constantly revising processes to accelerate customer adoption Experience working with cloud platforms including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services (AWS). Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures, including real-time data streaming, Change Data Capture (CDC), data integration, ETL/ELT, and event-driven architectures. Experience with technologies such as Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, or similar enterprise data platforms. Working knowledge of APIs, cloud networking, security, Linux/Unix environments, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Experience developing solution architectures, conducting proof-of-concepts, and supporting technical pre-sales or partner engagements. Programming or scripting experience with Python, Java, SQL, Shell, or similar languages. Excellent presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence both technical and business stakeholders. Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for a variety of audiences. Demonstrated curiosity and ability to quickly learn emerging technologies across cloud, AI, and enterprise data platforms. Experience incorporating AI-powered productivity or development tools into day-to-day work and an interest in applying AI to improve customer outcomes and technical workflows. Ability to travel up to 25% as needed. Preferred Qualifications Experience working for or closely partnering with Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, MongoDB, or other enterprise technology providers. Experience with cloud marketplaces, technology alliances, or joint go-to-market initiatives. Familiarity with enterprise AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Large Language Models (LLMs), Model Context Protocol (MCP), or agentic AI architectures. Experience working in high-growth SaaS, cloud infrastructure, data integration, or data modernization companies. title: Solutions Architect, AI Systems
description: Back to jobs New Solutions Architect, AI Systems United States Apply At Viral Nation, we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started. While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar! We have one of the largest and most advanced proprietary data infrastructures in the world, spanning social, customer, and sourced datasets. The next step is turning that data into scalable, AI-driven products — not just models and dashboards, but working software that ships. We're seeking a Solutions Architect, AI Systems who owns a problem end to end: scopes it with the business, designs the system, and then builds the first working version themselves. This is a builder's role. You architect the solution and you ship it — the two don't get handed off between different people. What You'll Do Here: Partner with executive, strategy, and client teams to scope AI and data solutions from an ambiguous business problem to a concrete technical plan. Design the system, then build and ship the first working version yourself — architecture and delivery sit with the same person. Build and deploy functional tools, models, and internal products on our proprietary data infrastructure (Snowflake, BigQuery) — not dashboards alone. Write and maintain working code (Python, SQL, APIs) to operationalize models and pipelines — doesn't need to be enterprise-grade, needs to run. Deploy applied AI methods — LLMs, embeddings, predictive modeling — as real, working features, not proofs of concept that stall at the deck stage. Collaborate with Data Engineering and AI teams to keep infrastructure aligned and data quality high as you build. Build internal enablement tools that let non-technical teams use and scale what you've shipped. Own your solutions past launch — monitor real usage, iterate, and improve. You'll Need To Have: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience demonstrating technical excellence and business fluency. 5+ years in Solutions Architecture, Applied AI/ML Engineering, or Data Engineering, with a track record of shipped, working software — not just designs, specs, or dashboards. Proficient in Python (or a comparable language) and SQL; comfortable writing and deploying code that runs in production, even if it isn't polished. Experience building and deploying models, pipelines, or applications on cloud data platforms such as Snowflake or BigQuery. Working knowledge of LLMs, embeddings, and applied AI methods, with real experience shipping them into working tools. BI tool fluency (Sigma, Tableau, Looker, Power BI) is a plus — not a substitute for engineering ability. Product mindset — comfortable owning a problem from an ambiguous ask through to a deployed, working solution. Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving problem spaces without a large team around you. Background in marketing, the creator economy, or social intelligence is a strong asset. Please include a link to something you've built and shipped — a repo, a deployed app, or a demo — with your application. Compensation Philosophy: At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels. Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact. AI in Recruitment: Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews. DEI Commitment: Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. title: Senior Engineering Manager - Loyalty Product
description: Back to jobs New Senior Engineering Manager - Loyalty Product Remote - United States Apply WHO WE ARE Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com. Role Overview Zeta Global is seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Loyalty product that powers the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP). Reporting to Sr. Director, Engineering, this leader will own the technical execution, architecture, roadmap, and delivery for one or more core loyalty features. The role requires strong technical judgment, exceptional engineering leadership, and the ability to drive complex initiatives across multiple engineering teams. Zeta Loyalty helps brands move beyond static loyalty programs with intelligent experiences designed to deepen engagement. The next gen Zeta Loyalty platform is envisioned to be AI-powered and agentic. This is a technical leadership role. The Senior Engineering Manager is expected to remain actively involved in architecture, design reviews, technical decision-making, and production operations while developing engineers and technical leads and delivering reliable Loyalty product capabilities at scale. Loyalty Product Mission Zeta Loyalty provides a configurable program definition, member foundation, reference data, rules engine, and offer capabilities required to launch enterprise grade loyalty programs. Rather than simply managing points, this product creates a flexible loyalty platform that enables brands to define their program, reward customer behaviors, and evolve their loyalty strategy without requiring custom engineering. The key mission of the product is tightly integrating with other services of the ZMP, such as identity, events, messaging and seamlessly executing the loyalty program rules based on user behavior. Additionally, there is an urgent need to integrate Loyalty with AthenaOS, Zeta’s AI-powered assistant, to bring predictive intelligence, real-time activation, conversational AI into the loyalty domain. Scope of Ownership Own the complete Loyalty product suite, which includes, but not limited to: Customizable loyalty programs Configurable reward rules Flexible tiering structure Reward points tracking Tight Integration with system notification & user messaging frameworks Omnichannel support Unified ZMP Identity Unified ZMP Analytics The Senior Engineering Manager is accountable for the architecture, implementation, operational excellence, observability, monitoring & reliability of the owned products. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership Lead the architecture and technical direction for assigned domains. Translate product strategy into executable engineering roadmaps. Participate in quarterly planning and deliver the workloads on a timely manner, with high quality Drive technical design for services, APIs, schemas, background jobs. Review designs and ensure alignment with platform architecture and engineering standards. Identify scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability risks. Champion reusable solutions and eliminate unnecessary duplication across different features. Engineering Leadership Build and lead a high-performing team of engineers and technical leads. Coach and develop engineers through mentoring, technical guidance, and regular feedback. Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering best practices within the team. Foster a culture of operational excellence, engineering quality, and continuous improvement. Balance new investments with operational responsibilities and technical debt. Work with other engineering teams to transform the Loyalty product into a seamlessly integrated ZMP offering Cross-Team Collaboration Partner with Product and Engineering teams, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, Security, and FinOps teams. Coordinate delivery of initiatives that span multiple engineering teams. Resolve technical dependencies and implementation challenges. Drive alignment around platform standards and engineering best practices. Communicate technical trade-offs, priorities, and delivery risks clearly. Reliability, Security, and Operational Excellence Ensure the product services & components meet availability, latency, scalability, and recovery objectives. Embed observability, monitoring, capacity planning, and operational readiness into platform design. Improve tenant isolation, workload fairness, and platform resiliency. Partner with Security teams to build secure-by-default platform capabilities. Drive continuous improvements in operational efficiency, reliability, and cloud cost optimization. Success Measures Success will be measured through: Delivery of Loyalty roadmap commitments Hire engineers, build and lead a team dedicated to development of the Loyalty product as per agreed plan Product availability, reliability, and operational health Improved developer productivity and satisfaction Successful migrations and retirement of legacy services Team engagement, growth, and engineering effectiveness Required Qualifications Significant experience building and operating large-scale distributed platforms or multi-tenant SaaS systems. Experience leading engineering teams responsible for application full-stack development. Strong technical expertise in distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native architectures, and shared platform services. Experience designing and operating highly available production services. Experience partnering with multiple engineering teams to deliver shared capabilities. Strong operational knowledge of observability, incident management, and production readiness. Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and grow technical leaders. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience building marketing technology, customer-data, analytics, or large-scale SaaS platforms. Experience with agentic applications, AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, Snowflake, Iceberg, PostgreSQL, Redis, Node.js, React.js, or similar technologies. Experience with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
